title: Survival I
body:
### About
This is a modpack aimed to improve your survival experience, by making it look, sound, and feel better with new redstone, world and visual changes to the game. Old bugs are also added back which I personally wanted, those being; the string dupe, and respawn immunity.

### Added Bugs
I felt it was a good idea to add these bugs back because it wouldn't affect the game too much. Yes string duping allows for infinite emeralds, but this can be done through different dupes which are much more harmful to the game. The spawn immunity bug I added back, because it gives you a chance to survive if you do it correctly.

### Notible Mods
1. Simple Wireless Redstone (by Matmoomate).
2. PolyFactory (by Patbox).
3. Serene Seasons (by Adubbz).
4. Hostile Mobs Improve Over Time (by KNIZE1007)
